steps: Go to netflix.com/youraccount and sign in.
Under the 'Membership & Billing' section, click the 'Cancel Membership' button.
Follow the prompts to confirm your cancellation.
Log in to your account page at spotify.com/account.
Scroll to 'Spotify Free' and click 'CANCEL PREMIUM'.
Open Tinder app, tap profile icon, go to Settings.
Scroll to 'Manage Payment Account' or click Subscriptions.
Log in to claude.ai and open Settings.
